title: Enabling Digital Experience for Device Groups

blocks.text: You can use Zscaler Service Entitlement to enroll Device Groups in Digital Experience. Configuring Digital Experience for device groups allows you to assign entitlements and policy settings based on ownership through device posture profiles. For example, one user can have two devices, one personal and one employer-provided. The personal device can be enrolled in Digital Experience, and the employer-provided device can be enrolled in Digital Experience and Private Access.
To enable Digital Experience for device groups, you must deploy Zscaler Client Connector 3.9 or later.

blocks.heading: Enabling Digital Experience for Device Groups

blocks.text: To enable Digital Experience for device groups:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Client Connector Entitlement > Digital Experience.

To enable Digital Experience for device groups, ensure that ZDX Enabled by Default is disabled. If this setting is enabled, Digital Experience is available for all users and you cannot assign Digital Experience to a device group.
To configure user groups, see Enabling Digital Experience for a Group of Users.

blocks.text: Groups are defined in the Device Groups section in the Zscaler Admin Console. For more information, see About Device Groups.

blocks.item: Select Logout Zscaler Client Connector when ZDX Entitlement is Enabled to automatically log users out of Zscaler Client Connector when Digital Experience is enabled for a device group. Users can then log in again to enable the Digital Experience service. This applies to customers using Private Access only or Private Access and Deception. When disabled, Zscaler Client Connector runs without the Digital Experience service until the next Zscaler Client Connector login.

blocks.text: Your users' devices are updated the next time they connect. If users are already connected, devices automatically update in 60 minutes. Users can manually update their devices in Zscaler Client Connector. On the More page, click Update Policy. After manually refreshing the device, they must reauthenticate on the Private Access page.
